changes.text: Usable from plain HTML: the new `dssoca/vanilla.css` stylesheet carries the `.ss-container` styles, so a `<div class="ss-container">` (plus `page` and `data-size-variant`) needs no Svelte and no JavaScript. Load it after `theme.css` or `tokens.css`; it requires CSS `@scope`.

New component: a centered, max-width page-content wrapper (`.ss-container`) with horizontal gutters that goes full-bleed on narrow viewports. The `page` prop makes it fill the viewport height and adds vertical page padding, and `size` (`sm`, `md`, `lg`) rescales the `--ss-container-max-w`, `--ss-container-px` and `--ss-container-page-py` tokens it reads.
